look: Sathya's AI for Real Life collage reel series: white paper-texture wall with grey vignette and drifting window / spot / soft light; full-colour pop-art sticker cut-outs pinned with heavy soft drop shadows; brand accents pink #FB3779 and blue #3C46FD only; pro camera rig travelling a tall world with parallax back plane, handheld drift, dutch tilts, snap punch-ins and whip cuts; Morven kicker over huge Allenoire headlines with random-letter reveals, Regarn Black tapes, stamps and nodes, hand-drawn pink wires and arrows; a ghost outline word behind every scene; AI for Real Life logo end card. Fonts are Sathya's files: Allenoire-400, Morven-400, Regarn 100/400/700/900. Instagram Reel 9:16, cut to the 24 Nov 2026 canary-token script's timecodes, no voice-over, SFX-only score, text inside the Reels safe zone. rich

scenes.name: The fake key
scenes.desc: Frame 0 mid-action: a typist hammers an AWS access key into a chat box, the key sticker pinned beside it; a stamp slams THIS KEY IS FAKE.

scenes.name: Zero Data Retention
scenes.desc: A vendor settings panel; the Zero Data Retention switch slides on, a tick lands, and the audit is declared done.

scenes.name: They tested it
scenes.desc: The settings panel greys out and slides away as a world map wakes up under a loupe; Dragos did not read the page.

scenes.name: One decoy
scenes.desc: One prompt splits along drawn pink wires into a one-off URL card and a unique AWS key card, with a canary perched between them.

scenes.name: The watched account
scenes.desc: The wire runs into an empty AWS account behind a vault door while an eye opens above it; the moment it is touched, LEAKED slams down.

scenes.name: Two million
scenes.desc: A counter climbs to 2,000,000 as a calendar burns from July to November and three servers go pink one by one.

scenes.name: A claim, not a control
scenes.desc: The ZERO DATA RETENTION badge is stamped, then two thirds of it floods pink as the fraction counts up.

scenes.name: Plant one
scenes.desc: Back on the fake key; a red pen strikes it through under SEND NOTHING YOU CAN'T BURN.

scenes.name: AI for Real Life
scenes.desc: End card: the AI for Real Life logo pops onto the brand blue.
